name: hosts: critical disk space (below 2 GiB)
description: Critical headroom on a writable root or persistent data volume. A 2 GiB buffer is smaller than routine build/package bursts. Uses the lowest sample over two minutes so a brief near-full event is not hidden by recovery. Excludes boot partitions, APFS helper volumes, simulator images, and bind-mount duplicates. Group identifies the host and mountpoint; inspect growth before deleting anything.
mplQuery: `host-metrics`:`system.filesystem.usage` | where state == "free" and mode == "rw" | where mountpoint in ["/", "/System/Volumes/Data", "/mnt/storage-01", "/mnt/xfs-vdo"] | group by `host.name`, mountpoint using min | align using min

name: hosts: low disk headroom (below 8 GiB)
description: Early warning before the 2 GiB critical limit: 8 GiB covers roughly one current host-update unpack. Uses the lowest free-space sample over five minutes and requires two consecutive evaluations. Low samples are not averaged away; recovered pressure remains visible for up to five minutes. Canonical writable root/data mounts only; laptops going offline do not trigger this alert.
mplQuery: `host-metrics`:`system.filesystem.usage` | where state == "free" and mode == "rw" | where mountpoint in ["/", "/System/Volumes/Data", "/mnt/storage-01", "/mnt/xfs-vdo"] | group by `host.name`, mountpoint using min | align using min

name: hosts: filesystem nearly full (below 10% free)
description: Relative-capacity warning complements absolute byte limits on larger disks. Includes free, used, and reserved states in total capacity. Canonical writable root/data mounts avoid APFS helper/simulator and bind-mount duplicates. Two consecutive evaluations of a five-minute window are required.
mplQuery: (`host-metrics`:`system.filesystem.usage` | where state == "free" and mode == "rw" | where mountpoint in ["/", "/System/Volumes/Data", "/mnt/storage-01", "/mnt/xfs-vdo"] | group by `host.name`, mountpoint using min, `host-metrics`:`system.filesystem.usage` | where mode == "rw" | where mountpoint in ["/", "/System/Volumes/Data", "/mnt/storage-01", "/mnt/xfs-vdo"] | group by `host.name`, mountpoint, state using max | group by `host.name`, mountpoint using sum) | compute free_fraction using / | align using min

name: hosts: storage guard unhealthy (htz-xfs)
description: Checks the newest working-storage-health result. Detects VDO physical usage >=80%, non-normal VDO mode, low root headroom, and probe/parse failures. VDO logical free space is not physical headroom. Missing health results for 15 minutes also alert; the sampler normally runs every five minutes.
aplQuery: ['papertrail'] | where ['resource.host.name'] == 'htz-xfs-lab' | where tostring(body._SYSTEMD_UNIT) == 'working-storage-health.service' | extend health = parse_json(tostring(body.MESSAGE)) | summarize arg_max(_time, health) by host = ['resource.host.name'] | summarize failed = max(iff(tobool(health.healthy) == true, 0, 1)) by host

name: hosts: kernel killed a process for lack of memory
description: Kernel OOM kill records, grouped per host. Restricts matching to kernel journal records so quoted errors in agent/user logs and systemd's duplicate status messages do not trigger it. This reports actual kills, not normal high RAM usage or caching.
aplQuery: ['papertrail'] | where tostring(body._TRANSPORT) == 'kernel' | extend message = tolower(tostring(body.MESSAGE)) | where message contains 'killed process' and message contains 'out of memory' | summarize oom_kills = count() by host = ['resource.host.name']

name: hosts: telemetry missing (htz-relay)
description: No host-metrics uptime samples for 15 minutes from this always-on server. Kept separate per expected server because an absent host cannot form a group in a fleet-wide query. Sleeping laptops are intentionally excluded.
mplQuery: `host-metrics`:`system.uptime` | where `host.name` == "htz-relay" | group using max | align using count
